line: Bitcoin drifted lower on the day's weakness and retreat in exchange inflows after three weeks of sustained accumulation, as the day's news stayed quiet on fundamentals.

wire_top3.line: Deutsche Bank to launch Bitcoin and Ethereum custody for institutional clients within weeks, targeting Asia expansion in 2027.
Federal judge denied joint Gemini-CFTC motion to void $5M settlement, holding that policy changes do not reopen voluntary settlements.
